RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 10

That number is a rough subjective estimate, not a statistically supported probability. An all-male panel raises a general question about representation, but does not by itself indicate sex influenced this decision—particularly when both you and the successful candidate are men.

Your longer experience and project leadership merit substantive feedback, but do not automatically make you the stronger candidate for a group-head role. Client relationships, commercial ability and people management may legitimately carry significant weight.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, and feedback on your assessment. Raise sex-related concerns if concrete evidence emerges, such as discriminatory comments or inconsistent treatment—not solely because of the panel’s composition.
